_readme: Solve-ent's palette, in the ROLE terms the hub's palette-check.mjs speaks (hub PALETTES.md §1). THIS FILE IS THE ONE SOURCE — public/css/tokens.css is GENERATED from it by tools/palette.mjs and drift-checked on every commit, so a colour cannot be declared in two places and disagree. The family is Instrument, the hub's recommended default, adopted rather than invented: it is the only one of the four whose worst text pairing is >= 4.87 across all four of its palettes, with primary text AAA on every fill and a mathematically exact-neutral night chrome. No picker: this app has one family, so palette and mode stay independent axes with only the mode axis populated.
_renders_readme: The role pairings this app was OBSERVED to paint, in the hub palette gate's own key format. MEASURED, NEVER TYPED: produced by `node tools/a11y.mjs --pairs`, which reverse-maps every rendered colour in every state and both modes back to the token it came from. The a11y gate fails when this list and a fresh reading differ, so it cannot go stale. The hub gate measures the full cross product of roles, which is what makes a palette PORTABLE; a missed floor on a pairing in this list is a defect on a screen somebody ships, and one off the list is a forecast about a screen nobody has built. Both are worth having and they are not the same severity.
